skill.name: popups
skill.description: Plan conversion-focused popups, modals, slide-ins, and banners with recommendations for copy, triggers, audience targeting, frequency limits, and accessibility.
skill.summary: Create popup strategies that balance conversions with respectful visitor experiences.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives: Markdown file references and respectful popup guidance do not execute commands or perform reconnaissance. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or data exfiltration in the reviewed files.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid manipulative: "No, I don't want to save money"

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks format local marketing-context filenames in Markdown, not executable shell or Ruby expressions. The instruction only requests reading relevant project context.
Line 227 discourages manipulative decline copy by quoting an example to avoid. It contains no system inspection command or reconnaissance instruction.
Lines 54-55 ask for easy dismissal and prohibit trapping or tricking visitors. These are interface principles, not network probing or discovery.

content.value_statement: Poorly timed popups interrupt visitors and weaken trust. This skill guides copy, targeting, triggers, and testing to balance conversions with a respectful experience.
actual_capabilities: Recommend popup formats for newsletter capture, lead magnets, discounts, announcements, and exit intent.
Draft headlines, supporting copy, action buttons, and polite decline options.
Suggest timing, scroll, click, session, and behavior-based triggers for different visitor contexts.
Define audience exclusions, frequency limits, dismissal cooldowns, and conflict rules for multiple popups.
Provide mobile layout, accessibility, consent, and privacy considerations.
Propose measurement events, conversion metrics, and A/B test hypotheses.
limitations: Provides written guidance rather than a deployable popup component or platform integration.
Does not collect analytics, run experiments, or verify live conversion performance.
Privacy and accessibility recommendations do not establish legal compliance or replace implementation testing.
Detailed form optimization, email follow-up, and experiment execution are referred to related skills.

use_cases.title: Plan a First-Purchase Offer
use_cases.description: Create discount popup copy with engagement-based triggers, clear terms, and suppression rules for existing customers.

use_cases.title: Promote a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Draft a dismissible announcement banner with audience targeting, a clear action, and a defined end date.

use_cases.title: Grow a Newsletter
use_cases.description: Plan a scroll-triggered subscription slide-in with relevant copy, minimal fields, and respectful frequency limits.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Newsletter Popup
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a newsletter popup for [audience] about [topic]. Include a headline, supporting copy, action button, polite decline, and suggested trigger.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Create a first popup concept.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Discount Offer
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a [discount] popup for first-time visitors to [store]. Recommend desktop and mobile triggers, eligibility, frequency limits, copy, and consent considerations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Define a targeted promotional popup.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce Popup Complaints
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this popup: [copy, trigger, targeting, frequency, metrics, complaints]. Prioritize improvements to dismissal, accessibility, exclusions, and mobile behavior. Propose test hypotheses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Improve an existing visitor experience.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multiple Campaigns
prompt_templates.prompt: Design coordinated newsletter, demo, and announcement popups for [site]. Define audiences, triggers, exclusions, conflict rules, mobile adaptations, measurement events, and A/B test hypotheses.

output_examples.input: Create a newsletter popup for an email marketing blog.
output: Format: Bottom slide-in after 50% scroll on relevant articles.
Headline: Get Weekly Email Marketing Tips.
Supporting copy: Receive one practical email every week.
Action: Send Me Weekly Tips. Decline: No thanks.
Rules: Exclude subscribers, show once per session, and wait 14 days after dismissal.
Mobile: Keep content visible and provide a large, accessible close control.

output_examples.input: Announce scheduled reports to existing users for two weeks.
output: Format: Dismissible banner at the top of relevant account pages.
Supporting copy: Receive reports automatically on your preferred schedule.
Targeting: Show to eligible users who have not enabled scheduled reports.
Rules: Remember dismissal, avoid competing overlays, and remove the banner after two weeks.

best_practices: Provide the popup goal, audience, traffic sources, current performance, and mobile usage before requesting recommendations.
Keep dismissal easy, honor preferences, and exclude visitors who already converted.
Test triggers and copy with submission, close, and engagement metrics before expanding a campaign.
anti_patterns: Show overlapping popups or repeat offers immediately after visitors dismiss them.
Use guilt-based decline copy, hidden close controls, or preselected marketing consent.
Treat suggested conversion benchmarks as guarantees or deploy mobile overlays without accessibility testing.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces popup strategy recommendations, copy, design notes, targeting rules, and test hypotheses.

faq.question: Does it install popups on my website?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, not a popup runtime or deployment integration.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help with mobile popups?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers mobile sizing, touch targets, dismissal, and alternatives to desktop cursor-based exit intent.

faq.question: Does it guarantee better conversions?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on your offer, audience, implementation, and testing. Supplied benchmarks are general guidance.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Share your goal, audience, offer, existing popup behavior, performance, and compliance requirements. It can also use existing local product marketing context.
